title: obistools: Data Enhancement and Quality Control of Marine Species Observations
description:
obistools is an R package for preparing datasets for publication to the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS) and for checking the quality of marine species occurrence records. OBIS is a global open-access data and information clearing-house on marine biodiversity for science, conservation and sustainable development.

With obistools, data providers can match scientific names to the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS), check that required Darwin Core fields are present, validate event dates, coordinates and depths (including points on land, using the OBIS xylookup service), check event and occurrence identifiers and the structure of event hierarchies, flatten Darwin Core event and occurrence tables, and generate data quality reports and maps.

Documentation is available at iobis.github.io/obistools. This archive contains the package source code from github.com/iobis/obistools.
